mandatory_checks: Exact source-grounded recall and full source read for all frozen positive/negative/superseded notes
Project isolation, deletion and clean-target restore
Evaluate matched newest-model panels with full cost; no incumbent preference
Both native-client fixtures capture the same fictional outcomes through upstream's own supported capture path
No extra default capture owner or cross-project leakage
Capture or index identical isolated cross-client fictional outcomes through native supported paths with exact source references
No substitute private transcript or protected source is ingested
Native file/session control preserves exact fictional facts and resume identity
Same downstream model/query sees source files; control is not declared a shared backend
Upstream native primitives write/update/delete/search the exact fixture through an isolated supported store
Application-owned integration boundary is explicit; primitives alone are not cross-client capture

boundary: Existing W6 roles and checks are preserved. Proposed source-pin updates do not amend the frozen comparison or authorize its run. No later omission or whole-layer adapter failure settles a dependency's role.
